rows: Built inBuilt in properties are set by the Nova Angular component itself or by its parent. These properties are generally not needed to be set or edited.

Sets the aria-pressed attribute to indicate the pressed (active) state of the button. Use [active] when you want to handle the active state of the toggle button. Use (activeChange) when you want the library to handle the active state of the toggle button, but get notified of changes. Use [(active)] when you want the active state to reflect changes by both you and the library.
Sets the value of the button to be used in the toggle container.

Sets checked state of component. Because 'checked' is a native attribute of input[type="checkbox"], it can only be set false by using [checked]="false", not checked="false" Use [checked] when you want to handle the checked state of the checkbox.
